info.name: Quipu Application Service
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Quipu Application Service microservice (port 3033). Covers datasources, realms, schemas, versions, atomic & document ingestion, entity/knowledge graph, RBAC, S3 file management, watcher, and admin/migration endpoints.

Collection variables:
- {{baseUrl}}  — default http://localhost:3033
- {{token}}    — JWT bearer token from your IdP
- {{tenantId}} — tenant identifier (X-Tenant-ID header)
- {{userId}}   — user identifier (User-Id header for migration endpoints)
